hook.en: The tea stall at your bus stand, the tailor in your lane and the small kirana shop are each owned, managed and controlled by one person. That person takes all the profit and bears all the loss.
hook.kn: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಚಹಾ ಅಂಗಡಿ, ಬೀದಿಯ ದರ್ಜಿ, ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ – ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಒಡೆತನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ಲಾಭವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ, ಎಲ್ಲ ನಷ್ಟವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ.

objectives.en: State the features of sole proprietorship

narration.en: The tea stall at your bus stand, the tailor in your lane and the small kirana shop are each owned, managed and controlled by one person. That person takes all the profit and bears all the loss.
narration.kn: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಚಹಾ ಅಂಗಡಿ, ಬೀದಿಯ ದರ್ಜಿ, ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ – ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಒಡೆತನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ಲಾಭವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ, ಎಲ್ಲ ನಷ್ಟವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ.

body.en: A sole proprietorship is owned, managed and controlled by one person who is the sole recipient of profit and sole bearer of risk. It is easy to form and close, the owner has unlimited liability and full control, and there is no separate legal entity. The business may end with the death, insanity or insolvency of the owner, so continuity is lacking.

points.en: Sole risk bearer and profit recipient

narration.en: A sole proprietorship is owned, managed and controlled by one person who is the sole recipient of profit and sole bearer of risk. It is easy to form and close, the owner has unlimited liability and full control, and there is no separate legal entity. The business may end with the death, insanity or insolvency of the owner, so continuity is lacking.
narration.kn: ಏಕಮಾಲೀಕತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ಮಾಲೀಕ, ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ. ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆ ಸುಲಭ, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ, ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವವಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: Its merits are quick decision making, confidentiality of information, direct incentive, a sense of accomplishment and ease of formation and closure. Its limitations are limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability and limited managerial ability.

points.en: Merits: quick decisions, secrecy, direct incentive, accomplishment, easy formation
Limitations: limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability, limited managerial ability

narration.en: Its merits are quick decision making, confidentiality of information, direct incentive, a sense of accomplishment and ease of formation and closure. Its limitations are limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability and limited managerial ability.
narration.kn: ತ್ವರಿತ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ, ಗೌಪ್ಯತೆ, ನೇರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹ ಇದರ ಅನುಕೂಲಗಳು; ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ, ಸೀಮಿತ ಆಯುಷ್ಯ, ಅಪರಿಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಇದರ ಮಿತಿಗಳು.

problem.en: Lakshmi runs a saree shop as a sole proprietor. Business debts are ₹8,00,000 and business assets are ₹5,50,000. She also owns a house worth ₹20,00,000. How will the creditors be paid?

steps.en: Liability is unlimited, so the shortfall can be recovered from her personal property such as the house.

answer.en: ₹2,50,000 can be recovered from her personal assets

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: One person owns, manages and controls the business.
points.kn: ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಮಾಲೀಕ, ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ.

points.en: Liability is unlimited: personal assets can be used for business debts.
points.kn: ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ: ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು.

points.en: There is no separate legal entity and no continuity.
points.kn: ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Best for small businesses needing personal attention.
points.kn: ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಗಮನ ಬೇಕಾದ ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ.

homework.en: Explain any three merits and three limitations of sole proprietorship.

narration.en: Recap. One person owns, manages and controls the business. Liability is unlimited: personal assets can be used for business debts. There is no separate legal entity and no continuity. Best for small businesses needing personal attention.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಒಬ್ಬನೇ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಮಾಲೀಕ, ನಿರ್ವಾಹಕ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ: ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಗಮನ ಬೇಕಾದ ಸಣ್ಣ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ.
